correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact system xdot=a-(b+1)x+x²y, ydot=bx-x²y for a,b>0. S=x+y obeys Sdot=a-x. Invariance applied to all smooth antiderivatives H(S) yields E[x|S]=a and Cov(x,S)=0. Consequently Cov(x,y)=-Var(x), Var(y)=Var(S)+Var(x), Var(x)=E[Sdot²]. Antiderivative tests K(x) yield E[y|x]=F(x)=((b+1)x-a)/x². The pointwise residual y-F=xdot/x² and conditional orthogonality yield Var(y)-Var(F)=E[(xdot/x²)²]. Compact positive support guarantees bounded x^{-1} and positive y_min, so F>=y_min on the x-support and x>a/(b+1). Zero Var(x) or Var(S) together with invariance forces x=a and y=b/a, giving all strict non-equilibrium cases. Independent SymPy symbolic cancellation checks for Sdot, nullcline residual and equilibrium passed. The Git tree SHA reconstructed exactly from the eight observed Git blob identities; packaged VERIFY_OK was not taken as a proof of analytic steps.
